citation.authors: Bastiansz A, Ewald J, Rodriguez Saldana V, Santa-Rios A et al

record.population: 41 papers from 22 countries; 787 product samples and 1,042 human biomarker measurements
record.design: Systematic review of mercury exposure from lightening products
record.finding: Mercury is widely present as an active ingredient. The Minamata Convention bans manufacture, import or export of lightening products above 1 ppm mercury.
